title: Arch Magus Vangl
summary: Arch Magus Vangl combines shifting focus with dangerous recurring converts.
overview: Defeat Vangl while killing the converts and removing Mark of Death before its delayed check. The scripted focus announcements do not themselves change his combat statistics.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Hold Vangl and collect each convert as it appears.

roles.label: Healers and support
tips: Arrange reliable mark removal before the thirty-second check.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Prioritize growing converts before returning to Vangl.

phases.label: Opening
phases.description: Control recurring converts and remove marks before they resolve.

phases.label: Faster marks
phases.description: The next mark scheduling uses a sixty-second cycle instead of seventy-five seconds.

phases.label: Final pressure
phases.description: Vangl casts Feedback Dispersion. Finish while continuing the existing add and mark mechanics.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Remove Mark of Death before its thirty-second check; a remaining mark triggers Cazic Touch.
Kill languished converts quickly because their damage grows over time.
Below 75%, subsequent mark cycles are shorter. At 10%, prepare for Feedback Dispersion.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
The reviewed source is standard or unversioned; this draft applies to version 0.
The 75% and 50% health handlers otherwise provide dialogue and camera effects; no extra damage modifier is claimed.
